notes.title: ⚠️🥋 BIG Update Released for Prologue!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934567/cf50fd57ca1829d3c090a09dca5daca8a0c098c0.jpg

Attention Martial Arts Masters! I've worked hard and released a new update.🥋🥋 
Here are the details:

[olist]
 🛠️ Massage Salon Quest: Language issue resolved and quest stabilized.
 👥 Student Interaction: Follow or Stop Following commands interface added when approaching our students.
 🏠 Massage Salon Area: Adjustments made to the massage salon quest area.
 🏙️ Town Visuals: Visual improvements made in the town.
 💰 Item Collection: Collecting items like money or potions from the ground is now easier.
 🏴‍☠️ Thief Behavior: Thieves no longer attempt to rob if the character has no money.
 👘 Uniform and Belts: Uniform and belt color changes for students now appear instantly on them.
 🐞 Quest Bugs: Quest acquisition bugs resolved and stabilized.
 🥋 Combat Mechanics: Opponents can no longer block when hit from behind during a fight.
 😴 Quest Stability: Sleeping Woman and Underwear quests stabilized.
 🤸‍♂️ Opponent Moves: Opponents now require two blocks during backward somersaults and two consecutive combo hits. You can no longer interrupt backward somersaults while they are in mid-air.
 🎮 Gamepad Support: Phase 1 completed, our game now partially supports GamePad controllers.
 🦵 Flying Kick: The Flying Kick technique no longer occupies a combo slot, appearing in a separate area instead.
 📚 Tutorial: A simple tutorial added to show how to add newly learned techniques to the attack slots.
 🦗 Grasshopper Student: Grasshopper student now fights to the death alongside us and does not flee during combat.
[/olist]

🥋 You can Download the Prologue Version from the link:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3081050/Fight_School_Simulator_Prologue/

Stay tuned! There are lots of suprises and story elements in the Full version and it is coming very soon.














🤖 AI Improvements: Improvements made to enemy and student AI.

notes.title: 🥋 Masters! Attention please: New Update is Released! 🥋
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934567/bedbd9eeafe81652dcd6307edcf2f3bc52afcb49.jpg

Dear Fight School Masters! 🥋 Attention please. I am happy to say that I have reviewed your feedback, watched some of your gameplay videos and released a quick update.

You can find the update details listed below:

Rival Students' AI
The AI logic of Rival Students and Enemies are improved. I am still working on this and making better and better day by day. 

Player Interaction Logic
Player interaction logic is changed. Now, we don't need to use R key for repair and F key for Follow. All we need to use (Interaction, Cleaning, Repearing, Building, Commanding our Students, etc.) is "E" and Mouse Leff Button.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934567/18b8042a4b4abaa96c6d1fb1331ffd8c60d92b84.png

Message Notification on UI
I have added a notification UI element on Scene. It is located on Top and Right and comes with an animation. So, you will be aware of you have a new message waiting on your Management desk.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934567/3417446f6d379f1248a2833eece54eb6e154d722.png

3 New Info Panel for Better Understanding of Game Mechanics.
I have added three new info panel about Why we need to do marketing? Who is Grasshopper? and What is the purpose of hanging Posters on our Walls? I think our players will have better understanding now.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934567/2c524fc76c867c6cc2b1e2f07d3aef55ce78f6c4.png
